title: Constitutional Capitalism v2.0 — Master Build Plan
purpose: Define what v2.0 means at 100% before researching, redesigning, funding, or piloting.

foundational_system.rule: v2 may challenge applications of v1, but it may not silently change v1 doctrine.

explorer_experience.rule: Enough grammar established; pause expansion until later stewardship resume.

blueprint.label: V2 BLUEPRINT
blueprint.completion_definition: 100% when all five gates pass: SEE → REDESIGN → FUND → LEGALIZE & BREAK → ROADMAP, measured by resolved objects — not words written.

epistemic_rules: UNKNOWN is a completed research result when the evidence needed for the current decision does not exist.
Preassign for every v2 question: decision, minimum evidence, source hierarchy, completion gate, deferred.
Deferred field protects against three-week rabbit holes when three facts would suffice.
No doctrinal drift through implementation — architectural amendments are explicit version events.
COUNTABLE remains $0 until proven. Hypotheticals are not revenue.
Every baseline object capable of geographic decomposition must be evaluated for State → Region → County applicability.
No county ranking from best to worst — compare dimensions.
County roles emerge from evidence; never pre-assign futures.
Populate county fields field-first across all 75 — not 75 sequential books.

gates.name: SEE ARKANSAS
gates.question: How does Arkansas actually work today?

gates.name: FUND ARKANSAS
gates.question: How does the redesigned state pay for itself?
gates.completion_result: Complete fiscal architecture with evidence-gated money flows
gates.countable_discipline: COUNTABLE remains $0 until waterfall proves cash. Hypotheticals are not revenue.

gates.name: LEGALIZE & BREAK IT
gates.question: Is it lawful, administrable, resilient and capture-resistant?
gates.completion_result: Hostile validation of the proposed operating model

entries.title: Open V2 Master Build Plan; freeze Explorer Experience 0.1 as HOLD
entries.decision: Define what v2.0 means at 100% before any Arkansas research campaign, fiscal modeling, agency redesign, tax rates, or pilots.
entries.why: v1 taught that completion requires a finish line. v2 must not confuse project growth with blueprint completion.
alternatives_rejected: Continuing Explorer expansion before V2 map freeze
entries.could_reverse_if: Plan fails orphan test or scope is shown incomplete after deliberate audit.
entries.v1_doctrine_impact: NONE — applications lane only; no silent doctrine change.

entries.title: Progress measured by resolved objects, not words written
entries.decision: V2 BLUEPRINT percent derives from object counters (baseline, functions, fiscal flows, legal pathways, households, geographies, propositions, implementation objects).
entries.why: Word-count and research volume inflated dials in earlier eras.
entries.could_reverse_if: Object taxonomy proven unfit after first gate — amend explicitly.

entries.title: UNKNOWN is a completed research result when needed evidence does not exist
entries.decision: When the evidence required for the current decision does not exist, record UNKNOWN as a completed result for that decision slot — do not endlessly research.
entries.why: Protects against three-week rabbit holes when three facts would suffice.
alternatives_rejected: Research until every box has a number
entries.could_reverse_if: Never — this is a permanent epistemic rule for v2.

entries.title: v2 may challenge applications of v1; may not silently change v1 doctrine
entries.decision: If implementation reveals a foundational proposition is defective, stop, label a potential v2.0 architectural amendment, run hostile test, and record version change.
entries.could_reverse_if: Never as a silent path — only explicit amendment process.

entries.title: Orphan / scope / completion audit PASS
entries.decision: Pass orphan test after assigning adversarial nominations (2 NEW domains: human_services, insurance_and_risk; remaining MERGE/HOME). Material orphans open = 0.
entries.why: Cannot open V2.1 until nothing important about operating Arkansas sits outside the map.
entries.could_reverse_if: A material operating surface is later shown with no HOME/MERGE path — reopen map amendment, do not silently research under wrong home.

entries.title: Freeze v2 build map
entries.decision: Freeze operating-system inventory at 38 domain homes. V2.1 OPEN_NOT_STARTED. Blueprint remains 0% until objects resolve.
entries.why: Define the entire job before attacking it in finite passes.
entries.could_reverse_if: Explicit map amendment after hostile gap — never silent domain drift.

orphan_audit.test_question: Can anything important about operating Arkansas exist outside the map?
orphan_audit.answer: Effectively no — every material operating domain has a known home (HOME, MERGE, or NEW_DOMAIN assigned).
orphan_audit.pass_criterion: Effectively no — every important operating domain has a known home.
method: Assign each nomination: HOME | MERGE | DEFER | NEW_DOMAIN
Freeze map only when residual orphans = 0 material items

nominations_log.why: Material DHS/SNAP/TANF/child-welfare operating surface not named as its own home.
Insurance markets and state regulation are a distinct operating surface from banking/credit.
Home under natural_resources + energy + water — expand home_notes.

orphan_audit.freeze_condition: Orphan test PASS + Master Plan accepted → freeze v2 build map → open V2.1 only.

forbidden_before_map_freeze: Fiscal modeling before V2.1 baseline objects require it
Tax rates / public-bank design before V2.3 evidence gates

architectural_amendment_protocol.trigger: Implementation or hostile test shows a foundational v1 proposition is defective.
steps: STOP application work on the affected proposition
Open explicit potential v2.0 architectural amendment record
Record version change (Foundational v1.x amendment or v2.0 doctrine revision as classified)
No silent rewrite of Public Book / Unabridged as if v1 always said the new thing

next_only: V2.1.4 — Institutions, Power & Constraints (who can change what; describe only).

map_freeze.rule: Inventory homes frozen. Research begins only under V2.1 evidence budgets. New domains require explicit amendment to the map.

forbidden_now: Skipping V2.1 baseline for premature redesign
Explorer expansion while V2.1 is the active build priority

geographic_dimension.decomposition_rule: Every baseline object capable of geographic decomposition must be evaluated for State → Region → County applicability. Not every metric needs county data. Every major system must ask whether geography materially changes the answer.
